(Note only that the two firms have very different revenue bases, so equal percentage gains represent very different dollar amounts.)

**Alphabet:** FY2022 revenue of $282,836M grew to FY2024 revenue of $350,018M [DOC-1], an increase of $67,182M, or 67,182 / 282,836 = **+23.8%** cumulative over the two years.

**Meta Platforms:** FY2022 revenue of $116,609M grew to FY2024 revenue of $164,501M [DOC-1], an increase of $47,892M, or 47,892 / 116,609 = **+41.1%** cumulative.

**Conclusion:** Meta grew faster, roughly 41.1% vs. 23.8%, a gap of about 17.3 percentage points (≈17). In dollar terms, however, Alphabet added more absolute revenue ($67.2B vs. $47.9B), since it grew off a base roughly 2.4x larger.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster — about 41.1% vs. Alphabet's 23.8%, a difference of roughly 17 percentage points (≈17.3 pp)
